title: Family physician
html_source:
Probably referring to ‘Virtue’s Household Physician, a Twentieth Century Medica’. Volumes 1-5, which was a popular book in the early 20th century UK. It included many anatomical drawings.

“A practical description in plain language of all the diseases of men, women and children, with the latest discoveries in medicine and most approved methods of treatment. Illustrated with manikins (separated colour overlays) coloured and half-tone plates.”
